categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the steel industry, including steelmaking, casting, rolling, and secondary processing. It also engages in coal chemical and specialty chemical products, carbon materials, environmental engineering, resource recycling, steel structure manufacturing, shipping and leasing, non-ferrous metals production and trading, IT system integration, general investment, steel brokerage, civil engineering, and renewable energy sectors such as solar and offshore wind power.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes integrated blast furnace and converter steelmaking processes, advanced metallurgical techniques for high-value and precision steel products, and innovative low-carbon and green steel technologies. It employs smart manufacturing technologies including AI-driven production control, energy-saving and carbon reduction technologies, and environmental protection systems such as low-temperature denitrification catalysts and carbon capture and utilization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries in construction, steel structures, transportation (shipbuilding, automotive, motorcycles, bicycles), metal products (fasteners, hand tools), machinery, electrical and electronics (home appliances, motors, computers), petrochemical pipelines, and communication servers. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant sales in Taiwan, Southeast Asia, Europe, Japan, and China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with manufacturing and headquarters located in Kaohsiung. It has overseas production and sales presence in Southeast Asia, Europe, Japan, China, Malaysia, Vietnam, and India. It also maintains sales and cutting centers in multiple countries including China, Southeast Asia, Japan, Italy, and Mexico.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly upstream and midstream in the steel supply chain, producing raw steel products from raw materials such as coal and iron ore, and supplying semi-finished and finished steel products to downstream metal processing and manufacturing industries. It also engages in downstream activities such as steel brokerage and technical services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-value precision steel products and green energy industries, pursuing digital transformation, low-carbon transition, and supply chain transformation. R&D focuses on advanced steel grades for tools, automotive, and green energy applications, smart production technologies, energy efficiency, carbon capture and utilization, and environmental protection technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of steel and related materials, engineering and construction services, and investments in renewable energy projects. The company also earns income from long-term investments and subsidiary operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading integrated steel producer in Taiwan with a strong market share in various steel product categories. It faces competition from major steel producers in China, Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia. The company emphasizes high-value and differentiated steel products to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$360.5 billion in 2023 with a net profit of NT$3.88 billion, showing a 10% increase in net profit compared to the previous year. It maintains substantial assets totaling over NT$695 billion and continues to invest heavily in capital expenditures, including environmental and energy projects, supporting steady growth and operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by focusing on high-technology, high-value-added precision steel products with superior performance characteristics such as high strength, toughness, and low carbon footprint. It integrates smart manufacturing and green technologies to offer environmentally friendly steel solutions, supporting customers’ sustainability goals and providing comprehensive technical services to enhance customer value.
